description: Shared Plans bucket rules (BRO-4481, docs/specs/shared-plans.md §2.2). One source of truth for three implementations: the get_shared_plans() SQL (tests/sql/plan-shares.test.sql), web selectSharedPlans (src/lib/shared-plans/select.ts) and the iOS port (lib/shared-plans-select.ts). Dates are DAY OFFSETS, not absolute dates, so the SQL test can anchor them to current_date and the JS tests to the venue-local date of `now`. Offsets are relative to the show's VENUE date at `now` (category -> zone via src/lib/calendar/timezone.ts; unmapped categories fall back to America/New_York).

fields.now: ISO instant the JS tests treat as now (defaults.now when absent)
fields.show: { id, category, status } as the resolver would return it
fields.plannedOffset: watchlist.planned_date as days from venue-local today; null = no date
fields.reviews: [{ seenOffset }] — seenOffset null = undated review (diary import)
fields.sqlIncluded: true when get_shared_plans() must return the row (the client then decides); false when it must never leave the database
fields.sqlLogged: expected value of the row's `logged` flag when sqlIncluded

cases.name: past date not yet logged stays private (to-be-rated)
yesterday not logged: database returns it (timezone slack), client excludes it
two days ago, not logged: last day of the database's slack window
three days ago, not logged: outside the slack, never leaves the database
past date logged on the planned day is want-to-see (app's not-booked rule)
past date with only an older review is still unlogged
undated review (diary import) counts as logged for a past date
re-booked after an earlier viewing is booked
closed show with no date is left out (client-side rule)
tonight's NYC show viewed late at night from Tokyo is still booked
West End show on the UK clock-change night is booked for the London date
unmapped category falls back to New York for 'today'
